jobs.title: Strategic Project Lead, Guidepoint Labs
jobs.location_raw: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description_text:
Overview:

Frontier models have already absorbed most of the public internet and generalist tasks, but they still lack the tacit judgment of experts who do complex professional work for a living. Bridging this gap requires identifying, verifying, and engaging a significant number of experts across many, often niche, domains over an extended period of time. And the specificity matters: not a physician, but an investigator who has actually run a Phase III oncology trial; not a generalist consultant, but a reimbursement lead who has negotiated with payers. 

Guidepoint Labs' human data team is leading the way to solve exactly that problem for frontier model builders and researchers building frontier models, having access on day one to millions of vetted experts across effectively every industry and deep into the sub-specialties, along with mature governance, compliance, and confidentiality infrastructure.

jobs.description_text:
About Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.  

Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.  is the global leader in innovating, developing, and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Amtagvi® (lifileucel) is the first FDA-approved, one-time treatment for previously treated advanced melanoma, now approved in three global markets and available at more than 95 authorized treatment centers. The Iovance TIL platform spans registrational trials and next-generation programs in additional solid tumors, including gene-edited and IL-12 tethered TIL therapies, next-generation IL-2, and precision immuno-oncology approaches. As the first and only company to take TIL therapy from concept to a broadly accessible commercial treatment, Iovance operates as an end-to-end cell therapy company, anchored by fully owned, centralized U.S.-based manufacturing that is scaled to serve thousands of cancer patients worldwide each year. For more information, please visit www.iovance.com.

Kodiak AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: KDK), founded in 2018, is a leader in Physical AI, developing driverless technology that powers machines that move. Its Kodiak Driver is a vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving system that combines AI-powered software with modular hardware. Today it operates in long-haul trucking, industrial trucking, and defense. Your Impact at LILA

Beyond your direct team, you will serve as a senior engineering leader across a broader portfolio of cross-disciplinary scientific computing efforts — coordinating strategy across workstreams that extend beyond your reporting structure and partnering closely with research and product leadership to bring Lila's scientific intelligence to customers at scale. This role requires both strong people leadership and the technical credibility to drive alignment and execution across a multi-team engineering portfolio.

  • Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and scientists; set the bar for technical excellence and foster a culture of collaboration and rapid iteration.

jobs.title: Co-Op, AI-Driven Equation Discovery
jobs.location_raw: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

The PS AI team sits at the intersection of Physical Sciences R&D and AI/ML. Lila runs high-throughput experiments across electrochemistry, formulations, and advanced materials, generating rich datasets that demand more than black-box models.

As a Co-Op focused on AI-driven equation discovery, you will develop and benchmark methods that extract interpretable governing equations directly from that data. Discovered equations reveal the underlying physics, make predictions explainable, and serve as mechanistic building blocks for digital twins and closed-loop optimization.

You will work alongside PS AI researchers and physical scientists, helping shape how Lila turns experimental data into scientific understanding at scale.

What You'll Be Building

  • Build end-to-end equation discovery pipelines from preprocessing through candidate generation and validation
  • Benchmark symbolic regression methods (SINDy, PDE-FIND, PySR, LLM-guided search) on Lila campaign data
  • Apply equation discovery to live electrochemistry, formulation, and materials datasets
  • Design evaluation harnesses measuring recovery rate, generalization, noise robustness, and physical consistency
  • Embed discovered equations into surrogate models, physics-informed models, and experimental digital twins
  • Translate open scientific questions into concrete problems with datasets, baseline

jobs.title: Co-Op, Bayesian Methods for Complex Decision Making
jobs.location_raw: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences builds AI systems that accelerate discovery across the physical and life sciences. Within Physical Sciences AI, we work with experimental teams to build autonomous discovery agents that decide which experiments Lila's AI Science Factories should run next.

Real scientific campaigns rarely look like textbook optimization problems. A single campaign can mix large discrete choices (which components, which recipe) with continuous settings (amounts, temperatures, times), pursue several objectives under hard constraints, and draw on evidence from literature and characterization data. Every experiment costs real time and materials. Off-the-shelf methods often struggle here, and they ignore the domain structure that could guide the search.

As a Bayesian Methods Co-Op, you will work alongside research scientists and engineers on a focused project within one broad question: how AI systems can make better experimental decisions. Depending on your background, that could mean building agents that choose the next experiment, testing when in-context learners can be trusted as decision-makers, or developing Bayesian strategies for tight experimental budgets. Your methods will be tested against live campaigns.

What You'll Be Building

  • Design and benchmark experiment-selection strategies that balance exploration and exploitation under realistic budgets
  • Build autonomous discove

jobs.title: Co-Op, Characterization Electrodeposited Material
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is hiring a co-op to join the Materials Science team within the Autonomous Science Platform. You will characterize electrodeposited metal films and develop the measurement methods that make those results repeatable. Deposition is handled by other scientists on the team; your focus is measurement, method development, and data quality.

The role spans electrical, surface, structural, and mechanical techniques: four-point probe for sheet resistance and resistivity, laser confocal metrology for thickness, step height, and roughness, XRD and EBSD for phase, texture, and grain structure, and hardness testing for mechanical properties. Much of the work is standing these methods up: defining sample prep, acquisition settings, and acceptance criteria so results hold across operators and sample batches.

You will work alongside scientists and engineers in a lab built for high-throughput, automated experimentation, and your protocols will feed directly into how these measurements get scaled.

What You'll Be Building

  • Develop sample prep and measurement protocols for general characterization tools on electrodeposited films: four-point probe, hardness testing, and SEM/EBSD.
  • Prepare samples for SEM and EBSD (mounting, polishing, surface cleanup)
  • Run four-point probe, laser confocal metrology, and hardness measurements
  • Analyze XRD data (phase ID, texture, pe

jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

The Editorial Content Co-Op joins Lila's Communications team to help tell the story of the company's scientific work across life sciences, materials science, and AI research. Output is published on lila.ai/news and Lila's social channels.

The co-op writes and produces content end to end: drafting articles and social copy, interviewing scientists about their work, scripting and producing short-form video, and building visuals that make complex science legible. They also contribute to content planning and launch strategy, and support occasional team events.

This is a good fit for a candidate who writes clearly about scientific subjects and wants real newsroom-style reps alongside working scientists. The co-op works directly with the editorial team, all former journalists, and reports to the hiring manager. The term runs January through May, based on site in Cambridge at our One Charles Park and Alewife offices.

If you do not check every box below but bring strong curiosity, grit, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Building

  • Draft articles, explainers, and social copy about Lila's scientific work

You’ll partner closely with the Deputy General Counsel, Litigation & IP and Senior Litigation Paralegal but operate with a high degree of autonomy—owning high-volume processes, driving execution, and developing creative solutions that enable the team to amplify its impact even as the company grows and scales.

About MSF USA | Doctors Without Borders

 

Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an independent international organization that provides medical care to the people who need it most. The organization cares for people affected by conflict, disease outbreaks, disasters, and social exclusion in more than 70 countries. MSF offers medical humanitarian assistance solely based on need, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, or politics. Our international project teams include medical, logistical, and administrative staff, most of them hired locally and working with their own communities. Our actions are guided by medical ethics and the principles of independence, impartiality, and neutrality. We also bear witness and speak out about the experiences of our colleagues and patients. 
 
MSF USA is one of 24 sections supporting the global movement, primarily through staff recruitment, fundraising, advocacy, and communications. We welcome candidates who bring a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to join us in working toward MSF’s social mission.
